lines.trans: Valentin? What are you doing in there?
Oh, I love this huge, luminous room!
No, get out quickly, that is Mathias's office!
It will be yours soon, won't it?
Camille Valentini Agency, that sounds great!
Stop it, Valentin, do not touch anything.
Look at all these beautiful prestigious bottles.
Mathias will be furious if he finds out.
Do not worry, we are safe and quiet here.
Sit down comfortably on this sofa.

words.gram: imperative, 2nd singular with hyphenated reflexive pronoun

lines.trans: What if we rehearsed my casting scene?
You want to rehearse your scene here now?
Yes, both of us are ready.
Okay, but just once then.

examples.text: Cette agence ne représente que des stars.

meanings.note: une agence artistique = a talent agency

examples.text: Ça va? Oui, ça va bien.
examples.trans: How are you? Yes, I'm fine.

meanings.note: ça va? = how are you? / are you okay?

examples.text: Samuel a oublié de vous apprendre la ténacité.
examples.trans: Samuel forgot to teach you tenacity.

examples.text: Il arrête de travailler à six heures.

examples.trans: A cushion to sit down on.

meanings.note: before the noun; bel before a vowel: un bel endroit
as a masculine noun: pour le bien de = for the good of

examples.trans: Look at this bottle of champagne!
Are you going to your desk?

examples.text: Elle me veut pour le casting!
examples.trans: She wants me for the casting!

meanings.en: casting, audition process (for a film or play)

meanings.note: before a noun: ce film, cette tête, ces gens
as a pronoun in c'est, ce n'est pas; becomes c' before a vowel

examples.trans: Make yourself comfortable on the sofa.

examples.text: La plus grande imprésario de Paris.

meanings.note: pour faire quoi? = to do what?
faire du vélo = to ride a bike, to cycle

examples.trans: I'm going to have lunch twice.

meanings.note: une fois, deux fois = once, twice

examples.text: Elle va être furieuse contre moi.
examples.trans: She's going to be furious with me.

meanings.note: furieux contre quelqu'un = furious with someone

examples.trans: I just want to see Mathias.

meanings.note: before the verb: vous la connaissez? les voilà

examples.text: Valentin? Qu'est-ce que tu fais là-dedans?
examples.trans: Valentin? What are you doing in there?

examples.text: Je veux, mais je ne peux pas.
examples.trans: I want to, but I can't.

meanings.note: ne ... pas: not; ne ... plus: not anymore; ne ... jamais: never
tag at the end of a question
everyday speech, with a he/she verb form

meanings.en: pas du tout: not at all

examples.trans: I have to see the play.

meanings.note: une école prestigieuse = a prestigious school

examples.text: Qu'est-ce que tu fais à Paris?
examples.trans: What are you doing in Paris?

meanings.note: starts a question: qu'est-ce que tu fais? = what are you doing?
in a sentence with ne: je ne sais rien

meanings.en: to rehearse, to practise (a role, a play)

meanings.note: une scène d'amour = a love scene
before the noun: le seul agent

examples.text: Si tu veux le rôle, tu dois changer.
examples.trans: If you want the part, you have to change.

meanings.note: ça sonne bien = it sounds good

examples.text: Si Kadropov sort avec une belle femme comme toi, il le dit à tout le monde!
examples.trans: If Kadropov goes out with a beautiful woman like you, he tells everyone!

meanings.note: passé composé with 'être': elle est sortie

meanings.en: sortir avec quelqu'un = to go out with someone, to date

examples.text: Le livre est sur la table.
examples.trans: The book is on the table.

meanings.note: sur la table, sur la route
before the verb; t' before a vowel

examples.text: Tu veux un autographe? — Le tien?
examples.trans: Do you want an autograph? — Yours?

examples.text: C'est mon verre ou le tien?
examples.trans: Is this my glass or yours?

meanings.en: le tien / la tienne / les tiens / les tiennes = yours (informal 'tu')
meanings.note: agrees in gender and number with the thing owned
informal, one owner; ton, ta, tes

examples.text: Je ne touche pas à mon visage.

meanings.en: toucher à: to touch, to tamper with
meanings.note: je ne touche pas à mon visage

examples.text: Ça ne va pas du tout.

meanings.note: oui à tout = yes to everything
plural tous (pronounced 'tous' with s): merci à tous
before a noun: tout le monde = everyone

meanings.en: laisser quelqu'un tranquille = to leave someone alone

meanings.note: singular and informal: friends, family, children, colleagues of the same age
+ noun: je veux un café; + infinitive: je veux partir
place: à Paris, à mon cours

meanings.en: au = à + le, aux = à + les
